name: Commander Vaishura
notes: An ancient Asura vanguard commander who led the first crossing through a Dwarka Gate according to tradition. He engineered the Asuran Agricultural Revolution, selectively breeding Permian synapsids as war mounts and draft animals. Commander of the Fang Vanguard, Master Breeder and Keeper of Forbidden Records are offices of the same individual. The Danava Keeper title survives in some catalogues. The order and dates of the offices remain unresolved. The earliest crossing is attributed to a Dwarka Gate tradition whose site has yet to be identified. The event register names him in the synapsid domestication. The surrounding Fang and Scale Wars and Gondwana intervention supply historical context.
sources: Gondwana: The Asura Intervention and the Fang Wars
